item.text: {"case_id":"SPR00353","decision":"candidate","candidate_ranking":["C01","C17","C15"],"selected_candidate_label":"C01","confidence":0.97,"relationship_type":"both","rationale":"C01 plausibly supplied concrete and material drafting machinery for the child. Both establish employment-security investigations administered through the Civil Service Commission, prescribe checks of substantially the same sources, escalate derogatory findings to an FBI full-field investigation, and enumerate nearly identical categories of disqualifying conduct and associations. The child broadens and reorganizes this machinery for all federal civilian employment, changes the governing security standard, and dismantles the prior loyalty-board system, but those adaptations do not defeat the strong textual and structural relationship. C17 and C15 contain weaker parallels involving agency-head responsibility, uniform government-wide standards, and central oversight, but lack C01's extensive matching investigative sequence and substantive criteria.","shared_material":[{"child_excerpt":"in no event shall the investigation include less than a national agency check (including a check of the fingerprint files of the Federal Bureau of Investigation), and written inquiries to appropriate local law-enforcement agencies, former employers and supervisors, references, and schools attended","parent_excerpt":"The preliminary investigation...shall include reference to: (a) Federal Bureau of Investigation files... (f) Local law-enforcement files... (g) Schools and colleges attended... (h) Former employers... (i) References","explanation":"The child closely reuses C01's distinctive checklist of investigative sources while compressing and adapting it to federal appointments generally."},{"child_excerpt":"Should there develop at any stage of investigation information indicating that the employment of any such person may not be clearly consistent with the interests of the national security, there shall be conducted with respect to such person a full field investigation","parent_excerpt":"Whenever information revealed with respect to any such person is derogatory...the United States Civil Service Commission shall forward the information to the Federal Bureau of Investigation, and the Bureau shall conduct a full field investigation","explanation":"Both use the same two-stage machinery: an initial investigation followed by a full-field investigation when adverse information appears."},{"child_excerpt":"There shall be referred promptly to the Federal Bureau of Investigation all investigations...which develop information...relating to any of the matters described in subdivisions (2) through (7)... In cases so referred to it, the Federal Bureau of Investigation shall make a full field investigation.","parent_excerpt":"the United States Civil Service Commission shall forward the information to the Federal Bureau of Investigation, and the Bureau shall conduct a full field investigation","explanation":"The same agency referral and investigative responsibility are retained in materially similar operative language."},{"child_excerpt":"Commission of any act of sabotage, espionage, treason, or sedition... Advocacy of use of force or violence to overthrow the government...
